name: Lohan (Arhat) Holding a Peach; Lohan (Arhat) Holding a Fu Dog
aliases: 羅漢持桃; 羅漢托福狗
material: porcelain with famille verte overglaze enamel decoration
summary: Lohan are disciples of Buddha with supernatural powers and eccentric behaviors. One lohan is holding the peach of longevity (shoutao), the other is holding the fu-dog, symbolizing good luck.
